helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.glob:
All items with Mending in equipment slots, main/off-hand,
hotbar and inventory are repaired when absorbing XP,
without needing to be held.
Items inside shulker boxes and other containers are ignored.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.bett:
When dying, any item with death protection (Totem of Undying)
in equipment slots, main/off-hand, hotbar and inventory
is triggered, without needing to be held.
Items inside shulker boxes and other containers are ignored.
Damage sources that bypass invulnerability (e.g. /kill)
are not protected, matching vanilla behavior.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.infi:
With 2+ water-filled buckets (water or fish buckets) across hotbar,
offhand and inventory, placing water in survival won't empty the bucket:
water buckets stay filled, fish buckets become water buckets.
Creative mode is unaffected.
helpful_tweake.config.hotkeys.comment.op: Opens the Helpful Tweake config GUI
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.bett:
Shows remaining durability as a number on items,
colored to match the durability bar.
Click the +/- button to configure Unbreaking estimation.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.dura:
When enabled, the displayed number accounts for the
Unbreaking enchantment, showing estimated actual uses
remaining instead of raw durability.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.shie:
Overlays a color layer on shields to show their status.
Green = available, red = on cooldown (5s disable after axe hit).
Your own shield cooldown is accurate.
Other players' cooldown is detected via shield disable component
(pose change) with sound monitoring as backup.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.armo:
Shows your 4 armor pieces on screen with durability info.
When 'Better Durability' is enabled, durability numbers
will appear on the armor items.
Click +/- to configure position and coordinates.

Position of the HUD on screen. Options: beside hotbar (left),
four corners, custom coordinates.

Only effective when Screen Position is 'Custom'.
0% = left edge, 100% = right edge.

Only effective when Screen Position is 'Custom'.
0% = top edge, 100% = bottom edge.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.visu:
Shows current level XP progress and total XP above the XP bar.
Click +/- to configure text color.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.expe: Color of the XP text display.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.worl:
Container config, provides no effect by itself.
Click +/- to expand sub-features.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.wsmR:
Renders a rotated 45-degree copy of target blocks,
offset along the render direction, for long-distance
visibility. Click +/- to configure render direction,
height, target blocks, waterlogged blocks, and distance.

Direction of the copy offset from the source block.
Options: Y+ up (default), Y- down, Z- north,
Z+ south, X- west, X+ east.

Blocks to offset the copy along the render direction.
Range 0-128, default 8.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.wsmT:
Block IDs to render copies for (e.g. minecraft:diamond_ore).
In 1.21.11, vault matches both normal and ominous vaults,
trial_spawner matches both spawner types.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.wsmR: Also render copies for all waterlogged blocks when enabled.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.wsmD:
Only render copies for blocks within this value x 16
horizontal Manhattan distance. Range 0-32,
default 4 (64 blocks).
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.wsmT:
When enabled, all bedrock becomes transparent,
revealing blocks behind it.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.wsmD:
When enabled, water and lava will no longer
react to form obsidian, cobblestone, or stone.
Requires server-side mod support.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.wsmC:
Automatically breaks kelp inside Litematica
selections within the 3D Manhattan distance.
Requires Litematica mod; shown in red and
disabled when not installed. Click +/- to
expand distance threshold.

Maximum 3D Manhattan distance (|dx|+|dy|+|dz|)
between kelp and player. Range 1-128, default 4.

When enabled, only kelp inside the Litematica
selection is cleared. When disabled, only the
distance to the player is checked.
helpful_tweake.message.clearKelp.litemat: Clear Kelp requires the Litematica mod
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.bett:
Master toggle for advancement screen features.
Click +/- to expand sub-options.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.show:
Shows all advancements in the advancement screen,
including hidden uncompleted ones (e.g. 'How Did We
Get Here?', 'A Voluntary Exile'). Uncompleted use
white background, completed use yellow, matching
vanilla coloring.

When hovering over accumulative advancements
(e.g. 'Adventuring Time', 'Monsters Hunted' with
multiple sub-goals), shows a list of sub-item
completion status on the right side of the
advancement screen. Red = uncompleted, green =
completed. Red on top, green on bottom, same
color sorted alphabetically.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.bigg:
Enlarges the advancement window to nearly fill
the screen, leaving a small margin on each side,
so more of the advancement tree is visible at
once. Turn off to restore the vanilla window
size.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.crea:
When enabled, shift+left-clicking an item in the
creative inventory tabs moves a single item
directly into the hotbar instead of picking
up a full stack on the cursor. The inventory
tab and normal containers are not affected.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.cont:
When enabled, opening a container GUI shows its
comparator signal strength to the right of the
container name, formatted like "Chest (0)".
Supports chests/barrels/shulker boxes/hoppers/
dispensers/droppers/furnaces/brewing stands,
updating live as items change. Display only.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.bett:
A collection of hopper minecart features.
Provides no effect on its own.
Click +/- to expand sub-features.

When enabled, with hitboxes visible (F3+B),
hopper minecarts display an extra box marking
their item pickup range. Items entering the box
can be collected by the minecart. The range covers
the contact area around the cart plus the suction
column above it.
Display only, does not change pickup logic.
Requires the master toggle to be enabled.
Click +/- to expand outline color and locked display.
helpful_tweake.config.tools.comment.hopp: Outline color of the pickup range boxes. Green by default.

When enabled, if a hopper minecart is locked by
a powered activator rail (unable to pick up items),
the suction column and contact area switch to
the locked color.
Click +/- to expand the locked color.
Outline color when the minecart is locked. Red by default.

When enabled, outlines the container a hopper minecart
is sucking from. The container sits above the cart (minecarts
pull items from above, not push below); vanilla tries to pull
items every tick in that case. The outline follows the
container block's actual shape. Does not require F3+B.
Requires the master toggle to be enabled.
Click +/- to expand the color option.
Color of the container outline. Green by default.

Line width of the container outline.
Range 1-10, 2 by default.
helpful_tweake.config.optimization.comme:
Fixes bold text offset issues with HD font packs.
Switches to cu_ prefixed bold font file and disables
the vanilla 1-pixel bold offset.
Requires a resource pack with cu_ prefixed font file.
Vanilla behavior is kept when no custom font is present.

Provides options to skip distant entities and
deduplicate stacked entities, reducing
unnecessary rendering overhead.
Click +/- to expand sub-options.

When enabled, entities farther than the
threshold from the player are not rendered.
Click +/- to expand distance threshold.

Entities farther than this value from the player
are not rendered. Range 1-128, default 32.

When enabled, only one entity of the same type
per block coordinate is rendered. Item entities
are grouped by item type, so different items
are each rendered once.

When enabled, the moving piston technical block
(B36) is not rendered. Blocks being pushed or
pulled by pistons are invisible during the
animation and reappear once it finishes.
Improves FPS in piston-heavy contraptions.

When enabled, if more than 70 hostile mobs are
in the same block, all their AI is removed
(pathfinding, attacks, targeting, etc.).
They still count toward the server's hostile
mob cap judgment, greatly reducing lag from
mob piles. Click +/- to expand sub-options.
Wardens Don't Dig When Hearing Sounds
helpful_tweake.config.optimization.comme:
When enabled, frozen Wardens keep the mechanism
of not digging down when hearing sounds
(hearing refreshes their dig cooldown), but do
not pathfind toward sounds or get angry.
When disabled, frozen Wardens are fully deaf.
Only active when Fake Peaceful Optimization is on.
